dialogues.jp: 昼休みなわけだが、さて、何を食うかな……。
dialogues.en: It's lunchtime, what should I have for lunch....
dialogues.text: It's lunchtime, what should I have for lunch....

dialogues.jp: パン買うか、さもなければ食堂へ行くか――。
dialogues.en: I guess I'd head for the cafeteria and buy some bread--
dialogues.text: I guess I'd head for the cafeteria and buy some bread--

dialogues.jp: 「……容赦なく二者択一だな」
dialogues.en: "...There isn't any alterative anyway."
dialogues.text: "...There isn't any alterative anyway."

dialogues.jp: なんかこう……もっと選択肢が欲しい所だ。
dialogues.en: Man... I wish there was more places to go.
dialogues.text: Man... I wish there was more places to go.

dialogues.jp:
ちら、と一瞬カセットコンロと鍋のビジュアル
が頭をよぎったが、首を振って打ち消した。
dialogues.en:
A vision of a portable grill and giant pot then popped in my
head, but it quickly disappeared.
dialogues.text:
A vision of a portable grill and giant pot then popped in my
head, but it quickly disappeared.

dialogues.jp: 「……あれを数のうちに入れちゃだめだろ」
dialogues.en: "...Two's company, and three's a crowd."
dialogues.text: "...Two's company, and three's a crowd."

dialogues.jp: なんとなく人として。
dialogues.en: It's always been like that, somehow or other.
dialogues.text: It's always been like that, somehow or other.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「どうした、悩める少年よ？」
dialogues.en: "You appear troubled, young thinker."
dialogues.text: "You appear troubled, young thinker."

dialogues.jp:
泰然とした声。見ると杉並が工藤と連れ立って
こちらへやって来るところだった。
dialogues.en:
A calm voice. I looked up to see Suginami and Kudou heading
in my direction.
dialogues.text:
A calm voice. I looked up to see Suginami and Kudou heading
in my direction.

dialogues.jp:
「いや……昼飯になにを食おうか、それが問題
　でな」
dialogues.en:
"Nothing... just wondering what I should eat for lunch
break."
dialogues.text:
"Nothing... just wondering what I should eat for lunch
break."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど、確かにそれは重要なテーマだ」
dialogues.en: "I see, a most important topic indeed."
dialogues.text: "I see, a most important topic indeed."

dialogues.jp: 腕を組み、深く頷く杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami folded his arms and nodded knowingly.
dialogues.text: Suginami folded his arms and nodded knowingly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「だから、お前らは大袈裟なんだって……」
dialogues.en: "You're always so overblown..."
dialogues.text: "You're always so overblown..."

dialogues.jp: 呆れたような口調で呟く工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou sighed deeply, one of exasperation perhaps.
dialogues.text: Kudou sighed deeply, one of exasperation perhaps.

dialogues.jp: 「お前達はもう食ったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Have you guys eaten already?"
dialogues.text: "Have you guys eaten already?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いいや、まだだけど」
dialogues.en: "No, not yet."
dialogues.text: "No, not yet."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ、折角こうして飢えたる同士が結集し
　たのだ。今日こそは外のファミレスで豪勢な
　ランチとしゃれ込もうではないか！」
dialogues.en:
"Then, we have to celebrate the coming together of the
starving comrades. Let us partake in a luxurious lunch at a
restaurant!"
dialogues.text:
"Then, we have to celebrate the coming together of the
starving comrades. Let us partake in a luxurious lunch at a
restaurant!"

dialogues.jp: そりゃ、出来るもんならそうしたいがな、
dialogues.en: That IS actually possible now...
dialogues.text: That IS actually possible now...

dialogues.jp:
「で、杉並よ、その『豪勢な』ランチには幾ら
　ほどかかるのだろうな」
dialogues.en:
"But, my friend, who will be paying for this "luxurious"
lunch?"
dialogues.text:
"But, my friend, who will be paying for this "luxurious"
lunch?"

dialogues.jp: 三人、顔を見合わせて意味ありげな沈黙。
dialogues.en: The three of us stared at each other in stock silence.
dialogues.text: The three of us stared at each other in stock silence.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「まあ、そこは笑顔と気合でなんとかなるとし
　てだな」
dialogues.en: "Well, that would be cause for happiness and joy."
dialogues.text: "Well, that would be cause for happiness and joy."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なるか！！」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean!!"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean!!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なるかあっ！！！」
dialogues.en: "What the hell do you mean!!"
dialogues.text: "What the hell do you mean!!"

dialogues.jp: 俺と工藤は息のあったツッコミをきめる。
dialogues.en: Kudou and I, in the same breath, both played the tsukkomi.
dialogues.text: Kudou and I, in the same breath, both played the tsukkomi.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「さすればここは工藤のオゴリということで」
dialogues.en: "Of course, I mean it's Kudou's treat."
dialogues.text: "Of course, I mean it's Kudou's treat."

dialogues.jp:
そんなツッコミのコンボをまったく意にも介さ
ず、見事な笑みを見せる杉並。
dialogues.en:
He gave a wry smile, returning our tsukkomi combination with
one of his own
dialogues.text:
He gave a wry smile, returning our tsukkomi combination with
one of his own

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんでそうなるんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Why on earth!?"
dialogues.text: "Why on earth!?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「いや、お前なら出してくれるんじゃないかと」
dialogues.en: "Well, you're the only one who can foot it, are you not?"
dialogues.text: "Well, you're the only one who can foot it, are you not?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「余計な金は持ってきてないんだよ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm not going to spend so friviously like that!"
dialogues.text: "I'm not going to spend so friviously like that!"

dialogues.jp: 工藤は躍起となって声をあげる。
dialogues.en: Kudou shouted out in desperation.
dialogues.text: Kudou shouted out in desperation.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、残念だな」
dialogues.en: "Oh well, too bad."
dialogues.text: "Oh well, too bad."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉……聞こえてるぞ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura... you agree?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura... you agree?"

dialogues.jp:
思わず本音の呟きをもらす俺を、工藤は横目で
じろりと｛にら／睨｝んだ。
dialogues.en:
Looking somewhat wary of my intentions, Kudou glanced
cautiously to his side, at me.
dialogues.text:
Looking somewhat wary of my intentions, Kudou glanced
cautiously to his side, at me.

dialogues.jp: 「んじゃ、しょーがない。学食でも行くか？」
dialogues.en: "Well, it can't be helped. The cafeteria for us, then?"
dialogues.text: "Well, it can't be helped. The cafeteria for us, then?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ま、俺達にはそのランクが似合いってとこか」
dialogues.en: "That's more suitable for our rank, yup."
dialogues.text: "That's more suitable for our rank, yup."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「うむぅ……背に腹は代えられん、か」
dialogues.en: "Hmph... sacrificing stature for your stomach, I see."
dialogues.text: "Hmph... sacrificing stature for your stomach, I see."

dialogues.jp:
ぶつぶつとぼやく杉並をひっぱって、俺達は食
堂へ向かった。
dialogues.en:
With Suginami shuffling his feet, we headed to the
cafeteria.
dialogues.text:
With Suginami shuffling his feet, we headed to the
cafeteria.

dialogues.jp: ◆トリオで昼食２◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lunch Trio 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lunch Trio 2◆

dialogues.jp:
杉並、工藤と豪華な昼食に想いを巡らすも、財
政の都合上、三人でおとなしく食堂に向かった
のだった。
dialogues.en:
Despite dreams of luxurious gourmet delicacies, due to
financial constraints, Suginami, Kudou and I ended up at the
cafeteria as usual.
dialogues.text:
Despite dreams of luxurious gourmet delicacies, due to
financial constraints, Suginami, Kudou and I ended up at the
cafeteria as usual.
